card.title: Apologize Properly
card.instruction: Get someone to deliver the apology in the form, order, and setting you consider valid.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your apology email needs a subject line mentioning the broken vase.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For all I know, that's about your choice of font.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send 'Sorry about the vase' to Mum. She still thinks you broke it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with 'I broke it.' My name comes out of the story before your apology goes in.

mechanism: A insists an apology email identify the incident and establish the offender's responsibility before expressing regret.
confusable: Unlike simply extracting an apology, A controls its written form and sequence to correct existing blame.
comparison: An email subject and first-person confession differ from the other alternative's table and in-person witness.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
